allow: PowerShell(try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15 | Select-Object StatusCode, StatusDescription } catch { $_.Exception.Message })

PowerShell($pages = @\("/leads", "/maps", "/analytics", "/ai-insights", "/settings"\); foreach \($p in $pages\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "OK $p -> $\($r.StatusCode\) \($\($r.Content.Length\) bytes\)" } catch { "FAIL $p -> $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $pages = @\("/dashboard", "/leads", "/maps", "/analytics", "/ai-insights", "/settings"\); foreach \($p in $pages\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "OK $p -> $\($r.StatusCode\) \($\($r.Content.Length\) bytes\)" } catch { "FAIL $p -> $\($_.Exception.Message.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(100, $_.Exception.Message.Length\)\)\)" } })

PowerShell($url = "https://wslstorestorage.blob.core.windows.net/wslblob/wsl_update_x64.msi"; $out = "$env:TEMP\\wsl_update_x64.msi"; Write-Output "Downloading WSL2 kernel update..."; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output "Downloaded to $out"; Write-Output "Installing..."; Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i `"$out`" /quiet /norestart" -Wait; Write-Output "Installation complete")

PowerShell(Write-Output "Installing WSL 2.6.3..."; Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i `"$env:TEMP\\wsl_latest.msi`" /quiet /norestart" -Wait; Write-Output "Installation complete. Checking WSL version..."; $ver = wsl --version 2>&1; Write-Output $ver)

PowerShell($msi = "$env:TEMP\\wsl_latest.msi"; Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i `"$msi`" /quiet /norestart" -Verb RunAs -Wait; Write-Output "Done. Checking for new wsl.exe..."; if \(Test-Path "C:\\Program Files\\WSL\\wsl.exe"\) { & "C:\\Program Files\\WSL\\wsl.exe" --version } else { where.exe wsl 2>&1 })

PowerShell(Start-Process powershell -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList "-Command `"Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Microsoft-Hyper-V -All -NoRestart; Write-Output 'Hyper-V enabled'`"" -Wait; Write-Output "Done")
